title: Docusaurus Companion mobile supervision capture
description: Launch the real Farmslot Companion app on its configured iOS simulator, connect it to a public-safe local fixture gateway, capture visible run supervision from the real app, and emit docs-ready proof artifacts without regenerating store screenshots.

start-fixture-gateway.intent: Serve public-safe fleet, run, decision, artifact, and terminal metadata through the real Companion websocket client path.

launch-companion.intent: Launch the real Companion development build with EXPO_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL pointing at the fixture gateway and the configured iOS simulator.

wait-for-supervision-ui.intent: Confirm Companion requested fleet.status and run.list from the fixture gateway before capture.

record-supervision.intent: Record the configured simulator and capture a final screenshot showing Companion supervising active runs, evidence, recipe, diff, slot, and terminal actions.
